title: helenium thapsoides
intro: Helenium thapsoides, commonly known as Sneezeweed, is a flowering plant native to the southwestern United States. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues such as colds and sinus congestion. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve coughs and congestion. Bioactive constituents of Sneezeweed include sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, which are responsible for its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
